name: gemv
summary: y = A x with A M x N row-major, x N, y M, all f32
provenance: authored for OpenAccel Lab (Apache-2.0); BLAS SGEMV (no transpose) with alpha=1, beta=0

y.why: each y[i] is a length-N dot product; in any summation order, fused or not, |err| <= gamma(N)*sum_j |A[i][j] x[j]| (Higham Thm 3.1/3.5); reference.py passes that sum as scale. WolframLanguageEvaluator: g[n_]:=n 2^-24/(1-n 2^-24); N[g[300],6] -> 1.78817*10^-5, N[g[17],6] -> 1.01328*10^-6, N[g[1],6] -> 5.96046*10^-8
